subject: Tri-zone demo alignment & rotating coverage proposal
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@wellpath.com>, Amira Khalid <amira.khalid@healthco.io>, Kenji Sato <ksato@medsys.jp>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Tri-zone demo alignment & rotating coverage proposal

Hi Liam / Amira / Kenji —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap before we lock the deep technical session:

- Primary goal: run a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (architecture + live inference run) with your infra and SRE leads.
- Success criteria: we show a consistent latency profile for your 512-token typical prompt, validate KV cache behavior for your streaming use case, and confirm deployment options (hosted vs dedicated).

To reduce repeated late-night scheduling overhead across your global team, we put together a simple rotating coverage plan where Redwood volunteers to shift demo windows on a 2-week cadence so the onus doesn't fall on the same region each time. High-level proposal:

1) Two-week blocks: 2 weeks US-friendly (morning ET / late afternoon PT) 
2) Next two weeks: Europe-friendly windows (late morning CET)
3) Next two weeks: APAC-friendly windows (early morning JST / AEST)

Concrete options for the next deep dive (please pick all that work and we will rotate if none are perfect):

- Option A (US-friendly): Tue Jul 15, 10:00–11:30 ET / 07:00–08:30 PT (UTC-4)
- Option B (EU-friendly): Wed Jul 16, 11:30–13:00 CET (UTC+2)
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu Jul 17, 09:00–10:30 JST (UTC+9)

Notes / asks:
- If you prefer, we can do a 45-min focused tech dive + 30-min Q&A; we found that short + focused often helps keep cross-org attendance high.
- Attached is a short outline for each window (RWI-tri-zone-demo-outline.pdf) and the provisional rotating calendar (proposed-rotation-calendar.ics).

Next steps: confirm which options work for each regional attendee and whether a 45 vs 60–90 minute format is preferred. If none fit, tell us 2–3 preferred times in your local TZ and we will map to the rotation.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,

Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@wellpath.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Amira Khalid <amira.khalid@healthco.io>, Kenji Sato <ksato@medsys.jp>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jul 2025 13:03:00 -0400 (EDT)
Subject: Re: Tri-zone demo alignment & rotating coverage proposal

Thanks, Olga — good summary. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We like the idea of a rotating responsibility so the same folks aren't always on odd hours.
- Preference: two-week blocks sound reasonable but could we avoid scheduling the APAC block later than 10:00 PM local for Amira's team; they have a blackout window after 22:00 JST.
- For the initial deep dive, Option A (Tue Jul 15 10:00 ET) and Option B (Wed Jul 16 11:30 CET) both look possible for the core group. Option C (Thu Jul 17 09:00 JST) is borderline — Kenji can do it but Amira would prefer we move APAC slots to early morning APAC (07:30–09:00 JST) where possible.

Suggested tweak: keep the 2-week rotation but shift APAC windows to 07:30 local start when feasible. Also prefer the 45-min focused + 30-min Q&A structure.

On availability: I'll confirm a final attendee list by EOD Tue so we can stamp the invite.

On quoting earlier: 
> To reduce repeated late-night scheduling overhead across your global team, we put together a simple rotating coverage plan where Redwood volunteers to shift demo windows on a 2-week cadence so the onus doesn't fall on the same region each time.

That last line is helpful — thanks for taking ownership on the rotation.

— Liam
Director of Platform Engineering | WellPath Health
liam.oconnor@wellpath.com | +1 (617) 555-0147
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 06 Jul 2025 20:20:00 +0100 (BST)
Subject: Internal: coverage for APAC-friendly demo windows

Olga / Marissa — quick internal note (not for external recipients):

Thanks — Liam's suggestion to shift APAC to early morning (07:30–09:00 JST) makes sense. I can take the first APAC-friendly demo on Jul 17 if we go that route, and Rohan can cover the subsequent APAC block the following month. Marissa — can you please provision the demo VM image with the sample workload (512-token prompt, streaming enabled) and add the small test prompts we agreed on to the shared Drive folder?

I'll create the rotating calendar entries once we have final confirmation on attendees. For the invite, I'd like to set the default session length to 75 minutes (45 + 30) and mark the agenda as locked so folks can see what's covered.

Ben

ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Tri-zone demo alignment & rotating coverage proposal — confirmed cadence and next steps

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Liam.

We will proceed with the 2-week rotation plan and the 45+30 minute structure. For this first session let's pick Option A (Tue Jul 15, 10:00–11:15 ET / 07:00–08:15 PT) and include a second-choice Option B (Wed Jul 16, 11:30–12:45 CET) as a backup — Ben will cover the APAC-friendly block when we enter that rotation and has agreed to the 07:30 JST start time going forward.

Action items (owners):
- Olga: I will send the calendar invite for Tue Jul 15 (75 min) and include the outline attached.
- Ben: set up the demo VM + test prompts in shared Drive (Marissa to assist).
- Liam / Amira / Kenji: confirm final attendee list by end of day Tue Jul 8.

I've attached the rotation calendar and the outline again. Expect an invite from me shortly with the provisional agenda and notes.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
